assignment_text: Should our school move the start time from 7:30 to 8:30 a.m.? Write a letter to the school board. Use the source.

source_passages.title: Teen Sleep and School Start Times
source_passages.author: Dr. Ortiz
source_passages.text: Melatonin arrives about two hours later at puberty, so most teenagers cannot fall asleep before about 11 p.m. In one survey, 7 in 10 high school students slept fewer than 8 hours on school nights.

essay_text: Dear School Board, the school should start at 8:30. Dr. Ortiz explains that teenagers cannot fall asleep before about 11 p.m., so waking at 6 for a 7:30 start means about seven hours of sleep, which is not enough. Some people say students will just stay up later, but the source says the problem is biology, not choice. A later start is a simple way to help students be awake for learning.
